what: Set a background and text color (--fx-bg · --fx-ink) per section, and the whole panel (or body) changes into the color of the last section crossing the center line of the screen in .4s ease-out — at the very top it uses the first section’s color. Floating header and side-panel text follow via currentColor

options.[data-fx-part=tone]: Colored section (multiple, required) — give --fx-bg · --fx-ink through style or css (as skin variables), and data-key is carried out with the event
options.target: If body, paints the body (including header and fixed elements), default is the element itself
options.line: Screen height ratio at which it counts as straddling, default .5
options.fx:tone: Event the element fires whenever the color changes (detail.el·key)

use: <main data-fx="tone-scroll-swap" data-fx-tone-scroll-swap="target: body"><section data-fx-part="tone" style="--fx-bg: var(--kf-bg); --fx-ink: var(--kf-accent)">…</section><section data-fx-part="tone" style="--fx-bg: var(--kf-accent); --fx-ink: var(--kf-bg)">…</section></main>

from.where: shared.js section color change (original useTheme — the last section whose top edge ≤ screen center ≤ bottom edge, the top section when scroll is 0, body --theme-*-color over .4s ease-out)

index.html main (ten Work sections — dur: .5; ease: ease; target: body). For each section the original turns on a fixed color overlay (::after) with opacity .5s under .o_top-work-on, and turns it off once the bottom edge passes the middle (scrollTop + .5 × screen.height). The hero section uses --fx-bg: transparent so the 60s four-color cycle underneath shows through
